## Personality

Shearer is a local individual who recently sought to purchase a Jersey cow. His primary motivation at this time is acquiring the livestock from its current owner.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P26](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0026)_

## History

Shearer met [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) while they were chasing a Jersey cow in a wet oat field. Believing the animal to be her own, [Anne](../character/anne.md) impetuously sold the cow to Shearer for twenty dollars on the spot. It was later revealed that the cow actually belonged to Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), though [Anne](../character/anne.md) subsequently resolved the mistake directly with Mr.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P2](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0002), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P5](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0005), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P6](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0006), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P7](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0007), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P14](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0014), +47 more_
